name: Shiraishi Nagomi
source:
A first year high school student in the same class as Minato. She has an air of mystery around her, strongly hinted of being an alien, and can be found just about anywhere at the right time. Is given the task of breaking up protagonist engagement.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akane_Iro_ni_Somaru_Saka]Wikipedia[/url].]

[spoiler] Has a twin sister that she cares for deeply. Her sister is a normal student and generic normal girl in comparison to Nagomi. [/spoiler]
